reviewed_by: Codex review of nebula-v3.0.13 selected release failures and production Host consent contract
reason: The v3.0.13 daily candidate scheduled its accepted matrix but failed selected Host startup, sticky Host acknowledgement, MCP import, Browser Repeater, narrow project switcher, compact Workbench navigation, desktop toolbar visual, and mobile WebKit goal-panel journeys. Creation now records explicit Host consent atomically while Scratch and API default creation remain pending. The goal helper waits for the visible entry point after Core's goal loads. Focused Python and component tests cover the policy boundary and UI request. Catalogued browser entries reproduce each failed journey on production real-Core LAN, desktop, mobile Chromium and WebKit, including 430 px WebKit goal access, the exact narrow viewport regression, and desktop navigation and visual profiles.
exclusions: No native shell behavior changed, so native tests are excluded. Unrelated provider, mission, notebook execution, packaging, and broad UI suites are excluded. The full suite was not requested. The daily release will separately run its change-aware browser selection and packaging gates after this repair merges.
